exposure: Severity of cesarean scar defect (moderate with residual myometrium vs. severe without residual myometrium)
Vaginal surgical repair for cesarean scar defect
outcome: Myometrial residual thickness (before and after surgery)
cohort: 53 women, between January 2014 and December 2019, who underwent vaginal surgery for symptomatic cesarean scar defect, categorized by the presence or absence of residual myometrium.
finding: Vaginal repair of both moderate and severe cesarean scar defects significantly increased myometrial thickness and reduced abnormal uterine bleeding, while also allowing women to achieve pregnancy.
mod_finding: All subsequent pregnancies after vaginal repair resulted in delivery by cesarean section at 38 weeks of gestation, with no uterine ruptures reported.
